free_tier.stated: No free storage allowance. App Storage is metered: $0.015/GiB/mo storage, $0.05/GiB data transfer, $0.0004/1k basic ops.

egress.terms: 'App Storage Data Transfer: $0.05 per GiB'. Plain metered egress, no free allowance.

tooling: S3-shaped API on top of GCS (buckets, access policies); usable with standard S3 tooling.
chaining: None. Metered storage plus metered egress means multiplying accounts multiplies the bill, not the capacity.
limits_note: 7-day minimum billing period per object; Starter plan gets 1 published app whose link 'will automatically go down after 30 days'; per-account storage limits are 'determined by plan' and not published as a number.
reliability_note: Backed by Google Cloud Storage with metered rates for storage and egress. No perpetual free storage tier is provided.
